usage: Runtime Open Source vulnerability alerts should not occur
name: Runtime secrets alerts should not occur
description: Exposing of secrets in runtime environment can increase the risk of breaches.
detailedDescription: Secrets can include passwords, API keys, tokens, and other credentials that allow access to valuable resources. If these secrets are exposed or fall into the wrong hands, they can be used to gain unauthorized access to data, infrastructure, or other services. This can lead to data breaches, information theft, or other malicious activities.
notes: Currently, this policy utilizes third-party integrations like Prisma Cloud.
